financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Gross proceeds from termination of capped call transactions related to the 2026 Notes
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On October 24, 2022, we entered into a termination agreement in connection to the capped call transactions described in Note 7 – Debt above related to the 2026 Notes. As a result, we received gross proceeds of $26.4 million.

warrants.quote: As of September 30, 2022, we had outstanding warrants issued pursuant to the Term Loan Agreement with a weighted average exercise price of $10.42 per share to purchase 12,957 shares of our common stock.
